adjudication.rationale: In `addGuests.handler.ts`, the constructed `evt: CalendarEvent` passed to `sendAddGuestsEmails(evt, guests)` never includes any `team` field (nor any team member list). In `email-manager.ts`, `sendAddGuestsEmails` only enters the team-member notification loop when `calendarEvent.team?.members` exists, so for this new add-guests flow that loop cannot execute. Since the booking fetch also only includes `eventType: true` (not `eventType.team`/members), the handler has no team data to populate `evt.team`, meaning team-member notifications won’t be sent from this pathway.
